pdf_explanation: The pattern on the left is rotated by 90° anticlockwise and then the lower letter is mirrored to get the pattern on right.
why: Figure 1 is turned 90° anticlockwise, so the right K goes to the top and the middle I lies flat. Then the lower K is mirrored (flipped top to bottom), so both Ks now face the same way. Do the same to figure 3: turn it anticlockwise and flip the lower F, and you get option 4. Option 3 looks very close, but it is turned clockwise, so the Fs point the wrong way.
trick: First find the rotation direction by tracking where one end of the figure goes, then check any extra flip on just one part.
note: PDF answer D checked against the figures and fits: anticlockwise rotation plus vertical mirror of the lower F gives two identical Fs with long prong on the left. Option C is the clockwise version.
